blocks.html: The title of Honorary Member of Università della Svizzera italiana is conferred as a way of honouring persons who "have particularly distinguished themselves for their commitment to supporting USI". It is conferred by the University Council, and is awarded during the Dies academicus.
The Honorary Members of USI are (in order of conferment, from most to least recent):

blocks.name: Mauro Martinoni
blocks.role: Università della Svizzera italiana Honorary Member
blocks.html:
For his witty, creative, and pragmatic commitment that allowed the foundation and development of Università della Svizzera italiana.

Conferred on 25 April 2026 during the 30th Dies academicus.

blocks.name: Marisa Garzoni
blocks.role: Università della Svizzera italiana Honorary Member
blocks.html:
For her constant, hospitable, and committed generosity, which has allowed USI to organise conferences, events, courses, and research projects aimed at peace and understanding between cultures

Conferred on 25 April 2026 during the 30th Dies academicus.

blocks.name: Arturo Licenziati
blocks.role: Università della Svizzera italiana Honorary Member
blocks.html:
For his decisive and generous support to the development of the Faculty of Biomedical Sciences at Università della Svizzera italiana

Conferred on 10 May 2025 during the 29th Dies academicus.

blocks.name: Giatgen Spinas
blocks.role: Honorary Member of Università della Svizzera italiana
blocks.html:
For his decisive and generous support for the birth and development of the Faculty of Biomedical Sciences.

Conferred on May 6, 2023, during the 27th Dies academicus.

Photo of the awarding

blocks.name: Lorenza Noseda
blocks.role: Honorary Member of Università della Svizzera italiana
blocks.html:
For the constant and precious contribution of the Associazione Amici dell’Accademia with its scholarships granted to students of the Academy of Architecture of Università della Svizzera italiana.

Conferred on May 5, 2018, during the 22nd Dies academicus.

The honour of Honorary President was bestowed upon the two Presidents in USI's history for their significant contribution to the development of USI:

blocks.name: Marco Baggiolini
blocks.html:
For his fundamental contribution to the development and success of USI nationally and internationally in its first decade and as an expression of the university community's profound gratitude for his clever work as USI's first President and of the scientific world's admiration for his work as a researcher.

Conferred on May 13, 2006, during the 10th Dies academicus.

Photo of the awarding

blocks.name: Piero Martinoli
blocks.html:
For his crucial role in advancing and promoting USI nationally and internationally during its second decade. He was instrumental in strengthening scientific research, establishing a centre for computational sciences, and creating the Faculty of Biomedical Sciences. This accolade reflects the University community's deep appreciation and the scientific world's high regard for his contributions as a researcher.

Conferred on May 6, 2023, during the 27th Dies academicus.

Photo of the awarding
